entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I'm a bit lost. I ordered something a while ago, and it's just not right. I need some help.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, and the email is s.miller@email.com.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you're one of our VIP members, thank you for being such a loyal customer. I see your recent order for the Apex Performance Jersey. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes, that's the one. The jersey. I think I got the wrong size.
Okay, I can look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference on the fit?
It's just the fit. It feels way too tight, and the sizing chart on the website was so confusing. I just want to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the portal. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. I can absolutely take care of this for you right now, no problem at all. I see here that the jersey was delivered 48 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get that exchanged.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I had missed the window.

Not at all. I've just processed the exchange for the next size up. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. All you need to do is box up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. As soon as we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new one.
Wow, okay.
And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added complimentary expedited shipping to your new order, so you'll have it in just a day or two after it ships. There's no extra charge for that.
That's amazing! Thank you so much, Alex. You made that so much easier than I thought it would be.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. We want to make sure you have gear you love. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that was everything. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day!
